title: Sunday · page forty
logline: A June Sunday: the estuary in wet-on-wet, two tiers. Tier three, ink: page forty of eighty. Halfway. The check stub hasn't come yet. The hand is faster now.

panels.composition: Tier 1: the estuary at low tide, June evening, wet-on-wet — gray-green, the mud a bruised violet, the far ridge with the faint glow.

panels.name: Estuary

panels.composition: Tier 2: a heron, alone, on the mud. Held.

panels.composition: Tier 3, ink: the hand, the cramped page — page 40, the register man again, now stacking boxes. Faster. Beside it, no stub yet. A caption.
panels.caption: Page forty of eighty. Nobody has paid for the first thirty-nine.
